programStatus: Local pilot built with five produced videos; no public deployment or schedule created

priorityMeaning.P0: Initial pilot; selected for teaching value and fit, not estimated demand
priorityMeaning.P1: Next commissions after reader evidence and distinct-intent review
priorityMeaning.P2: Research candidate; additional evidence or differentiation required

sourcePolicy: Sources are research inputs, not proof that page-specific claims or live product behavior have passed review. Repository-derived public documentation links must be checked before publication.
statusPolicy: planned-pilot means implementation commissioned; candidate means no publishing commitment; production-in-progress means source-reviewed local content with final media checks pending. Local production does not imply public publication.
expansionPolicy: No automatic publication. Complete all seven gates in strategy.md. Add at most two new lessons in week four and at most three pages in one proven cluster after the week-six review; these are proposed internal limits, not scheduled work.
measurementStatus: Search volumes, ranks, conversion, live analytics receipt, and indexing are unmeasured.

records.topic: How Mac automations see buttons
records.intent: Understand how a visible interface becomes structured UI information.
records.uniqueValue: Select a control in a modeled Mac window; see its AX role, label, hierarchy, and supported action change together.
records.productBridge: Read inspection docs, then explore Action for native computer use.

evidence.required: An explicit model label; two controls with different attributes; keyboard access; no implied live Mac inspection.

records.topic: Which permission does this Mac task need?
records.intent: Understand why a chosen observation or control task needs a permission.
records.uniqueValue: Choose a task and receive separate Accessibility, Screen Recording, and Automation explanations with relevant settings guidance.
records.productBridge: Connect each permission to a documented Lattices task, without requesting unrelated access.

evidence.required: Every task branch reviewed against current Apple guidance; version label; no live permission detection claim.

records.topic: UI elements or screenshots: choosing how to automate
records.intent: Choose an observation method for a particular task.
records.uniqueValue: Inspect the same scenario as pixels and as structured elements; see a case where each lacks useful information.
records.productBridge: Read inspection and verification docs before attempting a local action.

evidence.required: At least one incomplete-tree case and one useful semantic-action case; avoid universal speed or reliability claims.

records.topic: Rectangle and Lattices: snapping or workspace control?
records.intent: Decide whether window snapping satisfies the task.
records.uniqueValue: Compare one-window placement with bringing up a multi-window workspace; explain when staying with Rectangle is sufficient.
records.productBridge: Explore workspace layers only when the reader needs repeatable workspace organization.

evidence.required: Edition-specific capabilities and limitations; official citations; no hands-on or absence claims without evidence.

records.topic: Raycast and Lattices: launcher and workspace workflows
records.intent: Decide whether to extend an existing launcher workflow.
records.uniqueValue: Follow a launcher-driven task and a workspace-driven task; separate overlap from a useful complementary setup.
records.productBridge: Read how Lattices exposes workspace controls through its local API.

evidence.required: Current core-versus-extension distinctions; documented setup paths; no unsupported integration promise.

records.topic: Hammerspoon and Lattices: write a script or configure a workspace?
records.intent: Choose between custom Lua automation and predefined workspace operations.
records.uniqueValue: Compare the authoring and maintenance choices for the same bounded window task.
records.productBridge: Try a documented workspace configuration when custom code is unnecessary.

evidence.required: Representative code labeled illustrative unless executed; source citations; maintainability conclusions labeled analysis.

records.topic: Keyboard Maestro and Lattices: macros and workspace setup
records.intent: Decide whether the repeated task is a macro or a workspace arrangement.
records.uniqueValue: Separate triggering a sequence of app actions from preparing the windows and tools around that sequence.
records.productBridge: Use Lattices workspace setup alongside a macro; identify Action as a separate computer-use product.

evidence.required: Current feature sources; acknowledge macro tool strengths; do not imply all capabilities are equivalent.

records.topic: yabai and Lattices: command-driven tiling and workspace control
records.intent: Choose the setup and control model worth maintaining.
records.uniqueValue: Explain command/rule-driven tiling and map each advanced requirement to the specific feature that needs it.
records.productBridge: Explore Lattices' documented placement and workspace operations.

evidence.required: Feature-specific system requirements; exact current official sources; no blanket claim that all yabai use requires system changes.

records.topic: AeroSpace and Lattices: two workspace models
records.intent: Choose a keyboard and workspace model that fits daily work.
records.uniqueValue: Compare how a user defines, activates, and navigates workspaces without treating different workspace concepts as identical.
records.productBridge: Explore Lattices layers and project-related workspace control.

evidence.required: Official definitions; edition/version context if relevant; source-reviewed label until firsthand scenarios are tested.

records.topic: The invisible tree behind a Mac window
records.intent: Understand accessibility structure through motion.
records.uniqueValue: Transform a modeled window into a tree while retaining the link between each visible control and its semantic element.
records.productBridge: Try /learn/ax-tree after watching.

evidence.required: Rendered playable media, stable poster, transcript, synthetic-demo label, reviewed timing and exact media metadata.
evidence.reviewer: Source review plus independent content review and root artifact verification
evidence.testProcedure: HyperFrames checks, measured MP4 metadata, full decode, encoded-frame review, static-page audit and browser playback.
evidence.testResult: Passed locally. 36 seconds; 1280x720; H.264 at 30fps. No native app benchmark or public deployment claimed.

records.topic: Choose a way to automate your Mac
records.intent: Pick a first approach for a real repeated task.
records.uniqueValue: Route a task through existing shortcuts, app scripting, macros, workspace control, and UI automation based on what the reader needs.
records.productBridge: Recommend Lattices only for workspace tasks and Action only for the separate computer-use task.

evidence.required: Source and verify each branch; include a useful route that needs no new application.

records.topic: Why an automated click stops working
records.intent: Diagnose whether the target moved, changed, disappeared, or was never actionable.
records.uniqueValue: Replay one modeled workflow while changing position, label, enabled state, and timing; show the failed assumption.
records.productBridge: Connect fresh observation and verification to documented computer-use controls.

evidence.required: Different failure states produce different recovery advice; no blind retries or claims to fix arbitrary apps.

records.topic: Window snapping, tiling, and saved layouts
records.intent: Choose a window-management approach without learning product jargon.
records.uniqueValue: Move the same three windows through manual snapping, automatic tiling, and a saved arrangement; describe the user's control in each.
records.productBridge: Explore Lattices' placement and workspace model if a saved task context is useful.

evidence.required: Mechanisms clearly distinguished; conceptual layouts labeled; avoid unsupported competitor behavior.

records.topic: Mac Spaces and app workspaces are different things
records.intent: Understand where windows live before adopting a workspace utility.
records.uniqueValue: Trace a window, macOS Space, app workspace, and Lattices layer across a single task switch.
records.productBridge: Read the workspace map and layer documentation.

evidence.required: Current Apple Spaces source required in addition to product docs; definitions tested against current product versions.

records.topic: Inspect a Mac app without changing it
records.intent: Try a bounded, read-only inspection after understanding AX.
records.uniqueValue: Inspect a harmless standard control with Apple's Accessibility Inspector and compare the result with a saved annotated fixture.
records.productBridge: Optional deeper link to Lattices inspection docs after the native inspection lesson.

evidence.required: Firsthand procedure, exact macOS/Xcode versions, original redacted captures, and tested recovery for unavailable metadata.

records.topic: Why a Mac utility asks for permission again
records.intent: Investigate permission prompts after an app update or path change.
records.uniqueValue: Help the reader identify the exact app and installed path before applying a documented permission repair.
records.productBridge: Explain Lattices app identity and provenance only where verified.

evidence.required: Requires current Apple code-signing/identity sources and reproduced scenarios; no blanket TCC reset or unsupported diagnosis.

records.topic: When a keyboard shortcut should become a macro
records.intent: Find a manageable first personal automation.
records.uniqueValue: Break a repeated task into trigger, steps, decisions, and stopping condition; produce a readable plan for a macro tool.
records.productBridge: Use Lattices to prepare the workspace around the task, only if needed.

evidence.required: Working planner with examples; no claim to execute exported plans; do not collect typed workflow content in analytics.

records.topic: How to tell whether an automation actually worked
records.intent: Distinguish an issued action from the intended result.
records.uniqueValue: Compare a successful API response with unchanged UI, then choose a meaningful observed postcondition.
records.productBridge: Read Lattices' documented verification and receipt semantics.

evidence.required: Modeled failure and success examples; technical review of what response and observation each prove.

records.topic: Why a Mac click can land in the wrong place
records.intent: Understand screen coordinates, window-relative positions, and scale.
records.uniqueValue: Move a modeled window between differently scaled displays and inspect the coordinate conversion at a target.
records.productBridge: Read Lattices workspace coordinate contracts after the visual lesson.

evidence.required: Add official Apple geometry sources; verify numeric fixtures against native captures; do not present a browser calculation as a live diagnostic.

records.topic: Plan a useful multi-monitor workspace
records.intent: Arrange windows around a concrete task before selecting a window utility.
records.uniqueValue: Choose display arrangement and task windows, then compare readable layouts and a text description.
records.productBridge: Translate a supported layout into reviewed Lattices configuration guidance.

evidence.required: Real geometry and minimum-size constraints; readable keyboard/mobile alternative; export format validated before claiming compatibility.

records.topic: Why an app exposes fewer controls than you can see
records.intent: Recognize incomplete accessibility information and choose the next observation method.
records.uniqueValue: Compare a complete tree, a custom-drawn control, and a partially exposed interface without guessing hidden semantics.
records.productBridge: Use the AX-versus-screenshots lesson before choosing a documented inspection mode.

evidence.required: Distinct deeper question from the introductory comparison; primary sources plus original labeled fixtures; no unsupported per-app blacklist.

records.topic: App scripting or UI automation?
records.intent: Choose a documented app command before reconstructing a task as clicks.
records.uniqueValue: Compare a direct app operation, a keyboard sequence, and an AX action for one non-destructive task.
records.productBridge: Keep Lattices focused on the workspace and Action on UI interaction where needed.

evidence.required: Add official Apple scripting documentation and one tested application dictionary; avoid promising general app coverage.

records.topic: What a local API lets a Mac power user do
records.intent: Understand a local automation interface without starting with programming jargon.
records.uniqueValue: Assemble a read-only sample request from familiar workspace nouns; explain request, response, and connection boundaries.
records.productBridge: Open the Lattices API quickstart after building a sample request.

evidence.required: Never connect the public browser to a local daemon automatically; all sample schemas verified; label simulated responses.

records.topic: Make a development workspace repeatable
records.intent: Keep project tools and windows organized across task switches.
records.uniqueValue: Separate windows, processes, sessions, and restore behavior in a completed sample workspace plan.
records.productBridge: Optional Lattices configuration with tmux only where persistence is needed.

evidence.required: Explain process persistence versus window restoration; tested sample configuration before publishing executable instructions.

records.topic: Choose a Mac automation tool by the work it does
records.intent: Compare personal automation categories after a task is defined.
records.uniqueValue: Filter reviewed records by shortcuts, macros, scripting, workspace control, and native UI actions; show editorial reasoning.
records.productBridge: Present Lattices among workspace options and Action in its separate category.

evidence.required: Reuse reviewed facts; each category needs a distinct decision; do not create a second generic directory that duplicates /compare/.

records.topic: Choose a Mac window manager by how you work
records.intent: Select a window-control model and setup burden.
records.uniqueValue: Compare snapping, tiling, workspace organization, and scripting through concrete tasks with evidence links.
